privacy.heading: Privacy Policy (placeholder)
privacy.intro: This is a placeholder privacy policy for a MHTSdigiXR concept demo. Beacon Ridge Multispecialty Hospital is fictional and collects no real personal data — the forms on this site are demos and send nothing anywhere.

sections.title: What this demo collects
sections.body: Nothing. Form fields exist only to demonstrate validation and a success state; no data leaves your browser.

sections.title: Cookies
sections.body: This demo sets no analytics or tracking cookies.

sections.title: A real deployment
sections.body: A real hospital website would need a full privacy policy covering health-data handling consistent with applicable law (e.g. India's DPDP Act) before collecting any real patient information. That is out of scope for this concept demo.

terms.heading: Terms of Use (placeholder)
terms.intro: This is a placeholder terms-of-use page for a MHTSdigiXR concept demo.

sections.title: Demo content
sections.body: Every page on this site describes a fictional hospital, fictional staff, and fictional content, created solely to demonstrate MHTSdigiXR's Premium-tier web design and development capability.

sections.title: Not medical advice
sections.body: Nothing on this site constitutes medical advice, diagnosis, or treatment. Always consult a qualified clinician, and call your local emergency number for any real emergency.

sections.title: No real transactions
sections.body: No appointment, inquiry, or purchase made through this site is real. All forms are simulated.
